implementation.name: original-v1-calibration-ranges
implementation.scope: Original signed INT8 endpoints; same inputs and declared affine rounding/clipping policy.
implementation.question: How do range and zero-point change the stored value?

purpose: Observe the same real value clipping, encoding, and reconstructing differently in the original two mappings.
storyboard: Present real zero and trace both zero-point mappings.
Compare an interior input and an input clipped only by the symmetric range.
Compare saturation in both ranges, then reconstruct stored codes.
guard: Asymmetric rounded zero-point shifts representable endpoints slightly; no exact endpoint or accuracy promise.
